_README: Declares the exact strings that MUST be present, baked into the rendered pixels, for each asset that carries required text. Verified by scripts/verify_baked_text.py via OCR, fail-closed: if OCR cannot read the pixels the asset does NOT pass. Add an entry for any asset (especially AI-generated promo/social cards) whose brief bakes in the product name, a tagline, or the independence disclaimer. Set case_sensitive:true for tokens whose letterform matters (e.g. 'IDE' must not render as 'Ide'); leave it false (default) for prose so case differences in OCR output do not cause false failures.
_authoritativeDisclaimer: Full verbatim disclaimer lives in DISCLAIMER.md: 'not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially associated with Warp, Inc., ...'. The short marketplace form (package.nls.json) is: 'not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Warp.'

requiredStrings.text: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Warp
